title: Activity file with session totals but zero record messages
description: A 339-byte FIT activity file produced by Garmin Connect (the web platform, listed as creator). The file contains a valid activity/session/lap structure declaring a 40-minute, 4 km running activity on 2020-10-24, but contains zero `record` messages — the per-second time-series data is entirely absent. This shape arises in practice when summaries are exported without sample data, or when records are stripped server-side.

defects.notes: Activity, session, and lap messages are present and self-consistent (40:00 / 4 km), but there are no `record` messages at all. The full record-level time series is missing, not gappy.

expected_behavior: Parser must not crash on an activity with zero records. It should expose session/lap totals (duration 40:00, distance 4 km, sport running) and return an empty record stream — not synthesize fake records from the totals.
